notes: The Upscaler Store. Fetched from main like catalog.v2.json, used when newer than the built-in copy. Every entry is checked when loaded (StoreCatalog.Problems); one that breaks a rule is left out. Types: recipe, author-setup (Experimental only), user-supplied, link-only, builtin. Recipe steps: download, extract, copy, rename, ini-set, requires, message. Paths: {GameFolder} (the game's exe folder), {OptiScalerFolder} (OptiScaler's DLL folder inside it), {UpshiftData}\<entry id>. Bump "updated" with every change.

entries.name: HelixSR
entries.author: lonewolf0622
entries.license: Freeware, source not published (setup scripts Apache-2.0)
entries.description: Runs DLSS's network on AMD cards as an FSR 3.1 replacement in DirectX 12 games.
entries.notes: Set up once on the Updates page; then chosen per game as the upscaler. Its setup builds the network files on your PC from NVIDIA's DLSS DLL and deletes that DLL again.

entries.name: DLSS 5 build of OptiScaler (Skynizz)
entries.author: Skynizz
entries.description: An OptiScaler fork that adds DLSS 5 Neural Rendering with your own DLSS 5 file.
entries.notes: Needs NVIDIA's DLSS 5 file (nvngx_dlssnr.dll), which you supply in Settings. Switched per game on its Upscaling tab (More options > DLSS 5); Switch back returns the game to regular OptiScaler exactly.

entries.name: OptiScaler test builds
entries.author: OptiScaler team
entries.description: The OptiScaler team's daily builds, chosen per game next to Stable.
entries.notes: Allow them in Settings > OptiScaler, then pick Test build on a game's Upscaling tab. Needed for ANR and the FSR 4 model choice.

entries.name: ANR frame generation
entries.author: Apex Compute
entries.description: Apex Neural Rendering frame generation, in place of DLSS frame generation through OptiScaler.
entries.notes: A third-party beta that changes often and may crash or freeze games, especially on AMD. No licence is stated; allowed as an opt-in experiment. Needs an OptiScaler test build (custom frame generation providers) and a game with DLSS frame generation: turn that on in the game's menu. Only the add-on package's own folder is used; its install.cmd is never run.

recipe.text: Turn on frame generation in the game's own menu.

entries.name: AMD-NR (Neural Rendering on AMD)
entries.author: 3zwr1
entries.description: DLSS 5-style Neural Rendering on RX 7000 and RX 9000, built into an OptiScaler fork.
entries.notes: Lays the AMD-NR build of OptiScaler (v0.3.2) and its two runtimes over the OptiScaler Upshift installed; OptiScaler's own files are kept and come back when you remove it. Large downloads (about 540 MB and 110 MB). Press Home in the game to turn it on and off; the game asks which runtime to use the first time (lmxxf needs an RX 9000).

recipe.text: Press Home in the game to turn AMD-NR on and off.

entries.name: DittoSR
entries.author: Vancete
entries.description: A lightweight upscaler for handhelds and low-end PCs, also for VR.
entries.notes: Shown for information; follow the project's own instructions. Upshift doesn't download or install it.

entries.name: DLSS NR on Intel
entries.author: uzbekunknown
entries.description: Runs DLSS 5 Neural Rendering on Intel Arc cards.
entries.notes: Code only: no NVIDIA files or weights. You'd build it and supply NVIDIA's files yourself; Upshift doesn't download or install it.

entries.name: SCSKiller
entries.author: BlueHeisenberg
entries.description: Builds your games' shaders into the driver's cache before you play, against first-run stutter.
entries.notes: A separate program. Once it's installed, a game's Performance tab can open it.
